requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Morning, the mist outside the mountain gate hadn't dissipated yet."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Yunzhou, you've finally returned. Have you brought enough qi stones?"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Brought three bags, all from the best of the back mountain."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The ward has cracked again last night, Elder Qin didn't sleep all night."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The words hadn't finished when Wan Yi Qi Jing rushed up from below."}, {"id": 1, "text": "He gasped and said that there was a young woman lying by the side of the road at the foot of the mountain."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Quickly lift it up. If Yuè, go and fetch the medicine for treating injuries."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Wanwei Jing carried the unconscious woman into the main hall, the iron badge on his waist inscribed with: Qiushuang."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The injury isn't serious, just give her a Return Spirit Pill."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Ms. Zeng, Elder Qin asked you to go to the ward over there. I and Mr. Wan sit here."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Okay. Miss Chou is awake, quickly call me."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Wan Yi Jing scratched his head and turned to run towards the foot of the mountain."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Jiě Xuán stood at the entrance of the hall, his sword still sheathed, but the light flickered for a moment."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Qín Làngzhōng, bié lái wúyàng. Wǒ fèng gézhǔ zhī mìng, lái qǔ sān chéng língshí."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Three成? These qi stones were painstakingly collected by the sect. When will outsiders be allowed to take them?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "The ward has been breached, and the qi stones are not safe in your hands. I will return in three days."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Jiě Xuán snorted, turned and walked away, not even glancing back."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "He said three days is three days, and he never breaks his word."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Master Qin stroked his beard, looking at the unconscious Chou Shuang on the table."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Elder, let me go guard the ward. Miss Chu has 乐川 watching over her, I can go freely."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Finally, he nodded, took out a jade slip from his sleeve."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "This is the Eye Formation Order. Guarding it is the same as guarding your Dao."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Luòchuān put the medicine pouch into Yúnzhōu's arms, and then said a few quiet words."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "At the mountain entrance, Wan Yi Jia Jing delivered a蓑衣 (蓑衣 -蓑衣)."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Thank you, Senior Wan Yi Jia Jing. Miss You Chou has woken up, please say thank you for me."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Duan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the formation decree close to his body."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "In the hall, Cô Thúỡng slowly opened her eyes."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Wake up, it's fine. You've been unconscious for a whole day, don't move around randomly ▼"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Cou Shuang struggled to sit up and looked out at the torn curtain of sky."}, {"id": 1, "text": "No one noticed that a note in her sleeve was sealed with the seal of Jié Xuán."}]}

translations.13: Jiě Xuán stood at the entrance of the hall, his sword still sheathed, but the light flickered for a moment.

translations.16: The ward has been breached, and the qi stones are not safe in your hands. I will return in three days.
translations.17: Jiě Xuán snorted, turned and walked away, not even glancing back.
translations.18: He said three days is three days, and he never breaks his word.
translations.19: Master Qin stroked his beard, looking at the unconscious Chou Shuang on the table.
translations.2: Yunzhou, you've finally returned. Have you brought enough qi stones?
translations.20: Elder, let me go guard the ward. Miss Chu has 乐川 watching over her, I can go freely.
translations.21: Finally, he nodded, took out a jade slip from his sleeve.
translations.22: This is the Eye Formation Order. Guarding it is the same as guarding your Dao.
translations.23: Luòchuān put the medicine pouch into Yúnzhōu's arms, and then said a few quiet words.
translations.24: At the mountain entrance, Wan Yi Jia Jing delivered a蓑衣 (蓑衣 -蓑衣).
translations.25: Thank you, Senior Wan Yi Jia Jing. Miss You Chou has woken up, please say thank you for me.
